$comment: SCR-09 Sources & Methods content (docs/specs/03 SCR-09; 02 §C–§D; 01 FR-15; TASK-12 / T12.04).

processing.title: Offline Preprocessing Pipeline
processing.text: Pre-event Python pipeline: clips and reprojects USGS Gale DEM (1 m), HiRISE ortho mosaic (25 cm downsampled to 0.5 m), and THEMIS thermal inertia (100 m) to the local Mars equirectangular working projection. Generates the 5 m routing grid (elevation, slope p90, slope max, hazard flags), hab antenna coverage grid, SPICE geometry tables, DONKI event extraction, RAD event series, and packages site manifest with checksums.

processing.title: Optical Basemap (Ortho)
processing.text: USGS Mars MSL Gale Merged Orthophoto Mosaic 25 cm v3 (Calef & Parker 2016), grayscale 8-bit GeoTIFF; 25 cm/px native resolution, downsampled to 0.5 m for the application. Reprojected to local equirectangular working projection.

processing.title: Topography: Elevation and Hillshade
processing.text: USGS Mars MSL Gale Merged DEM 1 m v3 (Parker & Calef 2016), 32-bit floating point. Post spacing 1 m, tied to MOLA areoid. Reprojected to working projection at 1 m resolution, aggregated to 5 m routing grid. Hillshade derived at azimuth 315°, altitude 45° for display.

processing.title: Slope
processing.text: Derived via Horn method on the 1 m reprojected DEM to compute slope in degrees (0–90°). Aggregated to the 5 m routing grid as p90 (90th percentile, used for hard impassable limit) and max (maximum slope, used for caution flag 'micro-relief').

processing.title: Thermal Inertia
processing.text: USGS THEMIS Thermal Inertia Mosaic, Quantitative (32-bit), 100 m/px (Fergason et al. 2006). Units: tiu = J m⁻² K⁻¹ s⁻½. Resampled bilinearly for display and nearest-neighbor for flags. No defensible threshold for "possible loose fines" exists for this AOI (U-03, decided 2026-11-10), so no LOW_TI flag is set and the layer is display only. Gaps in the mosaic are labelled unknown, never zero.

models.title: Walking Speed and Step Cost
models.label: modelled — Earth hiking function scaled to an Apollo lunar planning speed; not validated for Mars suits or 0.38 g
models.text: Suited walking speed v(S) for directional gradient S = Δz / d (signed, uphill positive) between cell centres, normalized so v(0) = v₀ (suited flat speed, default 3.3 km/h from Apollo 17 lunar planning). Step time t includes caution multiplier m = 1.5 if slope_max > caution_slope_deg and m = 1.3 if flags & LOW_TI. A* search uses admissible heuristic h = straight-line distance / v_max, with v_max = v₀ · 6 / 5.037 ≈ 3.93 km/h at v₀ = 3.3 km/h.

models.title: Background Radiation Dose
models.label: measured background rate × planned duration (simplified)
models.text: Cumulative background surface dose equivalent = measured Gale crater background rate × planned duration. The rates and their ranges for solar maximum and solar minimum are read from the site's env_constants records (each with its source id), not repeated here. Excludes solar energetic particle events, suit/habitat shielding, terrain sky-blocking, and altitude differences within the AOI.

models.title: Mars24 Solar Conditions
models.label: derived — Mars24 celestial algorithm on IAU_2015:49900 spherical datum
models.text: Mars24 algorithm (Allison & McEwen 2000; GISS Mars24 technical notes): Mars Sol Date, L_s, equation of time, LTST, solar declination, and solar elevation and azimuth for the site's planetocentric latitude and longitude. EVA window sunrise and sunset use horizon = 0°, flat.

limitations.title: Topographic DTM Resolution and Artifacts
limitations.text: Post spacing is 1 m, but effective spatial resolution of photogrammetric DTMs is coarser than grid cell spacing. Micro-relief below effective DTM resolution (such as 1–2 m boxwork ridge heights, rocks, boulders, and small crevices) is smoothed and not mapped in the routing graph. Stereo DTM artifacts such as CCD seams, boxes, and faceted low-contrast areas may produce localized slope noise.

limitations.title: Slope Noise and the p90 Aggregate
limitations.text: Slope at 1 m is noisy where DTM artifacts exist; p90 reduces single-pixel spikes but can hide short steps.

limitations.title: Thermal Inertia Scale and Coverage
limitations.text: THEMIS thermal inertia native resolution is 100 m/px, so one thermal pixel covers 400 routing cells. Absolute accuracy is ~20 %. Areas with missing or poor coverage in the mosaic are marked unknown rather than assumed zero.

limitations.title: 8-Connected Grid Routing
limitations.text: Paths are grid-aligned (8 directions); micro-relief below effective DTM resolution is invisible and rocks/boulders are not mapped. Douglas–Peucker simplification (2 m tolerance) is for display only; metrics use the unsimplified cell path. Caution multipliers (m = 1.5, m = 1.3) are judgement, not physiology.

limitations.title: No Terrain Shadowing or Refraction
limitations.text: No terrain shadowing; no atmospheric refraction; dust opacity not modelled. Sunrise and sunset assume a flat horizon (elevation 0°).

ai_use.title: AI-Use Statement
ai_use.text: No AI computes or generates values in this app.
